body: 把上传合成人物转换成Kawaii珐琅徽章，保留短黑发、红圆眼镜、黄外套、青绿裤、白鞋和微笑，亮面金属轮廓、鲜艳珐琅色块，不添加新特征，单枚完整徽章白底方形样机，轻微投影。无文字。

en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

A single full-body pin uses shiny metal boundaries and saturated enamel, preserving the reference hair, glasses and clothing colors.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 56. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
